principles: Subject/form and domain are independent multi-label axes.
Choose only labels visibly supported by the crop or strongly supported by its bibliographic context.
Do not infer a specific species, person, place, or technical purpose unless the evidence supports it.
Other and uncertain are controlled labels, not substitutes for proposing a useful missing category.
New-label proposals are recorded without silently changing the controlled taxonomy.

subject_form.name: Subject / form
subject_form.instruction: Select every prominent depicted subject and every important visual form. Do not select incidental background details.

labels.name: Plant
labels.definition: A whole plant or recognisable botanical part, including flowers, fruit, leaves, roots, seeds, and trees.
exclude: purely decorative foliage with no botanical subject
openclip_prompts: a historical botanical illustration of a plant
an old book illustration of flowers leaves roots or trees

labels.name: Fungus
labels.definition: A mushroom, mould, or other fungus shown as the principal subject.
exclude: plants without fungi
openclip_prompts: a historical scientific illustration of mushrooms or fungi

labels.name: Animal
labels.definition: A non-human animal, including mammals, birds, fish, reptiles, insects, shells, and other invertebrates.
exclude: human figures
openclip_prompts: a historical zoological illustration of an animal
an old natural history illustration of birds fish insects mammals or shells

labels.name: Landscape or geological feature
labels.definition: A landscape, seascape, mountain, rock formation, terrain, or geological section presented pictorially.
exclude: maps where terrain is encoded cartographically
openclip_prompts: a historical landscape illustration
an old geological illustration of terrain or rock formations

labels.name: Human figure
labels.definition: One or more human figures where no more specific human label is necessary.
exclude: an isolated anatomical body part without a represented person
openclip_prompts: a historical book illustration of a human figure

labels.name: Portrait
labels.definition: A likeness focused on an identifiable or individualised person's face, head, bust, or body.
exclude: generic figures in a narrative scene
openclip_prompts: a historical engraved portrait of a person

labels.name: Human group or activity
labels.definition: People interacting, working, fighting, worshipping, travelling, or participating in a narrative or social scene.
exclude: a single static figure without a depicted activity
openclip_prompts: a historical illustration of people performing an activity
an old narrative scene with a group of people

labels.name: Anatomy or body part
labels.definition: An anatomical body, organ, skeleton, bone, muscle, tooth, tissue, or pathological specimen.
exclude: an ordinary portrait or clothed figure
openclip_prompts: a historical medical anatomy illustration
an old scientific illustration of organs bones muscles or body parts

labels.name: Architecture or built environment
labels.definition: A building, interior, monument, bridge, fortification, architectural elevation, detail, or built setting.
exclude: a purely cartographic street plan
openclip_prompts: a historical architectural illustration of a building
an old architectural elevation or detail

labels.name: Scientific or medical instrument
labels.definition: An instrument made for observation, measurement, experiment, diagnosis, or treatment.
exclude: general hand tools or complete machines
openclip_prompts: a historical scientific instrument illustration
an old medical or surgical instrument illustration

labels.name: Machine or mechanism
labels.definition: A machine, engine, mechanical assembly, moving mechanism, or mechanical section.
exclude: a single hand tool
openclip_prompts: a historical technical illustration of a machine or mechanism

labels.name: Tool, weapon, or implement
labels.definition: A hand tool, weapon, agricultural implement, or comparable functional object.
exclude: scientific measuring instruments
large machines
openclip_prompts: a historical illustration of tools weapons or implements

labels.name: Vessel or container
labels.definition: A vessel, bottle, jar, pot, box, or other container shown as a principal object.
exclude: ships and boats
containers incidental to a larger scene
openclip_prompts: a historical illustration of a vessel bottle jar or container

labels.name: Artefact or material object
labels.definition: A human-made object not better represented by architecture, instrument, machine, tool, weapon, or vessel.
exclude: objects that have a more specific available label
openclip_prompts: a historical illustration of an artefact or material object

labels.name: Map or plan
labels.definition: A cartographic map, route, site plan, topographic plan, floor plan, or spatial diagram.
exclude: pictorial landscapes without spatial encoding
openclip_prompts: a historical map or cartographic plan

labels.name: Astronomical or cosmological diagram
labels.definition: A diagram of celestial objects, constellations, planetary systems, calendars, cosmology, or astrology.
exclude: a pictorial night landscape
openclip_prompts: a historical astronomical cosmological or astrological diagram

labels.name: Mathematical or geometric diagram
labels.definition: A geometric construction, mathematical figure, projection, proportion study, or abstract spatial proof.
exclude: architectural plans without mathematical emphasis
openclip_prompts: a historical mathematical or geometric diagram

labels.name: Scientific or technical diagram
labels.definition: A schematic, labelled explanatory diagram, section, process diagram, or technical construction not covered by another diagram label.
exclude: unlabelled pictorial depictions
openclip_prompts: a historical scientific or technical diagram

labels.name: Chart, table, or tree
labels.definition: A data chart, graph, matrix, table, genealogy, branching tree, or node-link structure.
exclude: ordinary prose arranged in columns
openclip_prompts: a historical chart table genealogy or tree diagram

labels.name: Music notation
labels.definition: Written musical notation, tablature, or a diagram whose main information is musical.
exclude: musical instruments without notation
openclip_prompts: historical printed music notation or tablature

labels.name: Heraldry or emblem
labels.definition: A coat of arms, heraldic device, emblem, insignia, or symbolic badge.
exclude: ordinary decorative motifs without emblematic function
openclip_prompts: a historical heraldic coat of arms or emblem

labels.name: Seal, coin, or medal
labels.definition: A seal impression, stamp, coin, medal, token, or comparable circular or impressed object.
exclude: a generic circle in a diagram
openclip_prompts: a historical illustration of a seal coin medal or stamp

labels.name: Ornament or pattern
labels.definition: A decorative motif, repeating pattern, flourish, surface design, or ornamental composition.
exclude: scientifically depicted plants used as the subject
openclip_prompts: a historical decorative ornament or repeating pattern

labels.name: Initial, border, or book decoration
labels.name_zh_hant: 首字母、邊飾或書籍裝飾
labels.definition: A decorated initial, headpiece, tailpiece, border, printer's device, or page ornament tied to book layout.
exclude: independent ornamental artefacts
openclip_prompts: a historical decorated initial border headpiece or book ornament

labels.name: Mark, symbol, or inscription
labels.definition: A symbol, glyph, monogram, short inscription, calligraphic mark, or isolated written sign treated visually.
exclude: a full text block or ordinary prose
openclip_prompts: a historical mark symbol glyph monogram or inscription

labels.name: Other subject / form
labels.definition: A visible subject or form that does not fit the controlled labels. Add a proposed label and note.
exclude: cases where an existing label applies
cases that are merely difficult to recognise

labels.name: Uncertain subject / form
labels.definition: The crop does not provide enough evidence to choose a subject/form label reliably.
exclude: recognisable subjects covered by existing labels

domain.name: Domain
domain.instruction: Select every field of knowledge or practice substantially represented. A domain may be inferred from clear visual evidence or reliable book context, but not from similarity alone.

labels.name: Botany
labels.definition: Study and description of plants and fungi.
openclip_prompts: a historical botanical scientific illustration

labels.name: Zoology and natural history
labels.definition: Study and description of animals and the natural world.
openclip_prompts: a historical zoology or natural history illustration

labels.name: Geology and mineralogy
labels.definition: Earth materials, strata, fossils, minerals, and geological processes.
openclip_prompts: a historical geology mineralogy or fossil illustration

labels.name: Medicine and anatomy
labels.definition: Human or animal health, anatomy, physiology, pathology, diagnosis, or treatment.
openclip_prompts: a historical medical or anatomical illustration

labels.name: Surgery
labels.definition: Surgical procedures, operative anatomy, and surgical instruments.
openclip_prompts: a historical surgical illustration

labels.name: Pharmacy and materia medica
labels.definition: Medicinal substances, pharmacology, remedies, and preparation of medicines.
openclip_prompts: a historical pharmacy materia medica or medicinal plant illustration

labels.name: Agriculture and horticulture
labels.definition: Cultivation, farming, gardening, forestry, crops, livestock, and agricultural implements.
openclip_prompts: a historical agriculture horticulture or farming illustration

labels.name: Astronomy, astrology, and cosmology
labels.name_zh_hant: 天文學、占星術與宇宙論
labels.definition: Celestial observation, calendars, planetary systems, astrology, or models of the cosmos.
openclip_prompts: a historical astronomy astrology or cosmology diagram

labels.name: Mathematics and geometry
labels.definition: Arithmetic, geometry, proportion, measurement, and mathematical demonstration.
openclip_prompts: a historical mathematics or geometry diagram

labels.name: Geography and cartography
labels.definition: Places, territories, routes, topography, spatial knowledge, and map-making.
openclip_prompts: a historical geography or cartography illustration

labels.name: Engineering and technology
labels.definition: Machines, mechanisms, construction techniques, manufacturing, and applied technical knowledge.
openclip_prompts: a historical engineering technology or machinery illustration

labels.name: Architecture and design
labels.definition: Building design, architectural theory, construction, interiors, and designed environments.
openclip_prompts: a historical architecture or building design illustration

labels.name: Military and warfare
labels.definition: War, armed forces, fortification, weapons, tactics, and military technology.
openclip_prompts: a historical military warfare fortification or weapons illustration

labels.name: Navigation and maritime knowledge
labels.definition: Ships, sailing, navigation, nautical instruments, ports, and maritime practice.
openclip_prompts: a historical navigation maritime or nautical illustration

labels.name: Religion and mythology
labels.definition: Religious practice, sacred narratives, deities, saints, ritual, cosmological belief, and mythology.
openclip_prompts: a historical religious sacred or mythological illustration

labels.name: History, genealogy, and heraldry
labels.definition: Historical record, lineage, dynastic relations, coats of arms, commemoration, and antiquarian history.
openclip_prompts: a historical genealogy heraldry or historical record illustration

labels.name: Literature and narrative
labels.definition: Literary works, drama, poetry, allegory, fiction, and narrative scenes.
openclip_prompts: a historical literary or narrative book illustration

labels.name: Society and everyday life
labels.definition: Occupations, customs, dress, domestic life, leisure, social roles, and ordinary activities.
openclip_prompts: a historical illustration of society customs or everyday life

labels.name: Art, ornament, and material culture
labels.definition: Visual art, decorative design, craft, artefacts, collecting, and the study of material objects.
openclip_prompts: a historical art ornament craft or material culture illustration

labels.name: Music
labels.definition: Musical notation, theory, instruments, performance, and musical practice.
openclip_prompts: a historical music notation instrument or performance illustration

labels.name: Other domain
labels.definition: A clearly represented domain is absent from the controlled taxonomy. Add a proposed label and note.

labels.name: Uncertain domain
labels.definition: There is insufficient visual or contextual evidence to assign a domain reliably.

disposition.instruction: Record whether this crop belongs in the illustration corpus before assigning content labels.

labels.name: Include
labels.definition: A usable illustration, diagram, ornament, or other intentional graphic.

labels.name: Exclude: not an illustration
labels.definition: A text block, blank region, scanning artefact, library mark, or other detector false positive.

labels.name: Exclude: unusable crop
labels.definition: The underlying graphic may be valid, but this crop is too incomplete or poor to annotate.

labels.name: Uncertain
labels.definition: The crop's inclusion status cannot yet be decided.

labels.name: Partial crop
labels.definition: A meaningful part of the graphic is cut off.

labels.name: Excessive surrounding text
labels.definition: The crop includes substantial unrelated page text.

labels.name: Fragmented or composite
labels.definition: The crop contains fragments or several graphics that cannot be treated as one coherent illustration.

labels.name: Low resolution or blur
labels.definition: Image quality materially impairs interpretation.

labels.name: Blank or low-information
labels.definition: The crop contains too little visual information for useful annotation.

labels.name: Likely duplicate
labels.definition: The same graphic probably occurs elsewhere in the dataset.

labels.name: Caption or title only
labels.definition: The detected area is primarily a caption, label, or title without the associated graphic.

labels.name: Text-block false positive
labels.definition: Ordinary prose or tabular text was detected as an illustration.
